role: Business Intelligence Engineer, Capacity Delivery Reliability
responsibilities: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable solutions for ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to support analytical and business needs.
Work directly with customers to understand the business problems at hand and propose impactful analyses and solutions.
Partner with data engineers to develop automated solutions.
Develop a deep understanding of our vast data sources and identify which to use to solve specific business problems.
Manage prioritization of business intelligence requests, allocate work across the team, and be responsible for communications with our customers.
Lead the creation of user-friendly repeatable reporting solutions to minimize ad hoc customer requests.
Serve as a senior SME and lead for SQL and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
Write high quality SQL to retrieve and analyze data from relational databases (e.g., AWS Redshift).
Manage and improve our internal customer communication channels (e.g., wikis, data dictionaries).

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: "high quality SQL" and "careful attention to detail" sit against one "fast-paced and ever-changing environment", so rigour, though the signal is thin.

evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Infrastructure capacity metrics for internal leaders with no regulatory or financial-reporting language, so moderate.

evidence.data_team_maturity: collaborate with both business owners and other analytics teams
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Several analytics teams, data engineers and data dictionaries already exist across AWS Infrastructure Services, so mature.

evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: A few bullets name SQL, Tableau and Redshift, but most are generic ("Work directly with customers"), so mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: mining large and diverse data sets from across AWS Infrastructure
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is internal infrastructure business partners and leaders served through metrics, dashboards and data dictionaries, so internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Manage prioritization of business intelligence requests, allocate work across the team
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role leads design and team prioritisation while answering business partners' questions, so mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The posting does not mention AI.
